messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — AcmeRetail trial showing 25% activation. Multiple users hitting SSO redirect error 'redirect_mismatch' during first model run. Need a quick rescue before renewal conversation. @devon_csm can you triage? :eyes:
devon_csm: on it. I saw one error in the auth callback logs earlier. Putting ashley_se on the thread for a quick review of the redirect URIs.
ashley_se: copy — I can check the app client config. Most likely mismatch between prod and trial callback. If we confirm, fix is to add the trial redirect to the client and push a small config patch.
maria_cs: need suggested messaging for the customer while we fix — don't want them to assume the product is flaky.
ashley_se: suggested quick note: "Thanks for flagging — we hit an auth redirect edge for org trials. Our engineering team will patch your callback URL within the hour. We’ll keep you posted and extend the trial 14 days to make up for disruption." Pasteable: ```Hi <CustomerName>, we identified an auth redirect mismatch impacting sign-in. Engineers are applying a fix now; we’ll update you within 60–90 minutes and extend your trial by 14 days. Apologies for the interruption — thank you for your patience.```
devon_csm: nice. I'll send that and book a 30m call for tomorrow to walk through onboarding flows. Also creating a CS ticket and tagging eng-runtime.
ops_bot: Ticket created: CS-4721 — "AcmeRetail trial SSO redirect_mismatch" (assigned to devon_csm). Link: https://zendesk.example/CS-4721
remy_manager: quick reminder — mark this as high-risk renewal (trial friction). Flag in Gainsight and set outreach cadence: 24h check-in + weekly until activation passes 80%.
maria_cs: agreed. Action items: 1) ashley to apply redirect fix (ETA 45m) 2) devon to send customer message + schedule call 3) remy to set risk flag and outreach cadence 4) ops_bot to monitor ticket and confirm when resolved.
ashley_se: applied patch to client config and redeployed auth service. Verified success flow in staging. Please ask customer to retry sign-in; if still failing, send me the exact redirect URL they see.
ops_bot: CS-4721 status updated: Resolved -> Pending customer verification.
devon_csm: message sent and call scheduled. Customer replied: "Thanks — trying now."
maria_cs: sweet. If they verify, apply trial extension and close the loop in Gainsight. If not, escalate to eng-runtime and offer live screen-share.
remy_manager: also capture enablement feedback: which part of onboarding confused them (SSO docs, redirect steps). Add to the trial-friction playbook: checklist item "validate redirect URIs in client config" and sample email template.
maria_cs: created a playbook card: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/trial-friction — added template and checklist.
ops_bot: Action log: [2024-10-07T15:14:00Z] patch deployed, [2024-10-07T15:22:00Z] msg sent, [2024-10-07T15:30:00Z] customer verifying."
